task: Extract four fields from a supplied synthetic status memo and cite an exact source line for each field.
prompt: Return only a JSON object with keys project, owner, due_date, status, and evidence. Use only the memo. Copy project, owner, due_date, and status exactly from their labeled lines. Evidence must be an object with those same four keys, each containing the entire exact source line supporting the copied value. If a labeled field is absent, use null for its value and evidence. No inferred values or prose.

acceptance.mandatory: All four values and all four evidence lines exactly match the independent synthetic memo specification; JSON parses; no extra keys.
acceptance.quality_floor: At least 9 of 10 cases accepted in each repetition; any fabricated value or evidence rejects the case.
acceptance.grader: Deterministic exact comparison against labels created with the memos, before provider output; no model grading. Provider is hidden from the grader's input object.
